name: Furnace Court
world_constraints: Campaign rules: Luck is PC-only; all NPC current/max Luck and rank Luck bonuses are0. Classic Fantasy Imperative combat: repeat initiative cycles while usable AP remain, one proactive Action per TURN not per round. Delay conserves actions, paid when used. Engaged Regain Footing costs1AP and requires opposed Brawn or Athletics; no rank exemption. Nearby dropped weapon recovery costs2Actions (reach then ready). Fightingwhileprone is Formidable. Rank4 CFI AP=2base+2rank=4. Track specific mastery free parries/ripostes distinctly; do not doublecharge them. No free standing or pickup.
description: Public glassworking court in the Merchant Quarter; east stair reaches the Glasswalk, west canal stair, north glass workshop, south alley.
staging_notes: SENSE: hot mineral smell, furnace draught, ringing tools. SHAPE: 20x15m court; east stair rises3m to roof terrace; west canal stair, north Doria workshop, south6m alley. LIVES: glassworkers including Doria. HANDS: cooling trough, sand cart, tongs, ladders, shutters. COSTS: public access; active furnaces are real hazards only on contact. TURNS: shutters shelter civilians; cart blocks alley; canals provide escape. KEY: furnacelight beneath blue night.
